# Northstar Works Annual Leave Guide

Northstar Works is a fictional organization. Full-time employees receive 20
working days of annual leave per calendar year. New employees receive a
prorated allowance based on their start date.

Submit a leave request through the fictional People Portal at least five
working days before the first day away. The employee's team manager reviews
the request. Contact the fictional People Operations team when a balance or
policy detail is unclear.

This sample policy is not legal or employment advice.
